cases.scope: Full-radius native clear segments crossing the latest intended rectangle, in a fixed original snapshot. An open witness proves a local traversable gap. Zero witnesses does not prove global enclosure, gate usefulness, attacker route arrival or protection. No commands, RNG draws, clock advance or repaired geometry.
